newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen rising on stronger demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen rising on stronger demand.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates, which held steady last week, are likely to rise slightly in the next few days on increased demand, dealers said on Monday.
They said gold had stood steady as the dollar was in demand after a 7.86 percent devaluation on October 22.
"More players are now switching into gold," one dealer said, predicting that the dollar would slip in the kerb market on profit-taking.
Slver prices were unchanged last week and were likely to remain steady this week due to a lack of demand, the dealer said.
